verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator stores 2FA credentials, so breach or weak/reused/exposed-credential warnings are a fair security-posture question for it. The evidence covers only code sync, transfer, editing, offline generation, Privacy Screen and HOTP/TOTP support. Nothing shows breach monitoring or credential-health alerts, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed
